summary: Frontend-only regression of /justicesquare after Amnesty removal, hero rewrite and 8 infographics datasets. All acceptance criteria pass. Feeds JSON returns 200 with reports=10 (no Amnesty) and infographics=8. Hero shows 4 stat cards with the required values and German labels. Reports section has 10 cards, no Amnesty filter/card, TRM filter still present, 4 'Letzte Aktualisierung' badges visible. Infographics section shows all 8 tabs (festnahmen, asyl, institutionen, sensitive, folter, folter-art3, lebensrecht, deportationen); institutionen renders a bar chart with 4 categories and hover tooltip; folter tab renders 4 gender bars; heading remains 'Interaktive Infografiken & Statistiken'. News renders 5 cards with 4 filters (Alle + 3 categories). Multimedia uses data-testid prefix 'multimedia-card-' (4 cards). Useful links: 14 total, Amnesty entry absent. Mobile 390px renders single-column, no React runtime crash observed.
critical_code_review_comments: JusticeSquarePage.tsx still ~600 lines — consider splitting the News/Reports/Infographics/Multimedia/UsefulLinks blocks into subcomponents.
Spec mentioned test-id prefix 'media-card-' for multimedia; actual code uses 'multimedia-card-'. Naming is fine but keep spec/data-testids in sync.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright on external preview URL. Feeds JSON: reports=10 (no Amnesty), infographics=8. Hero: 4 cards with data-testid hero-stat-stat-{arrests,khk,ecthr,renditions}. Report filter for Amnesty absent; report cards = 10. Infographic tabs use data-testid infographic-chart-tab-<key>; chart uses data-testid infographic-chart-<key>; tooltip data-testid=chart-tooltip fires on hover. Multimedia cards use data-testid multimedia-card-<id> (not media-card-). Useful link ul-amnesty absent; 14 useful-link buttons total.
